note: State park on the bluffs at the Niobrara-Missouri confluence, NE Nebraska. The modern campground is one paved loop with an inner row, east of the park road below the bluffs; the east row backs onto a thick tree belt along a river backwater, with no water view. Carpets on the asphalt pads only. Tent camping on a separate hilly one-way loop. --Claude
summary: ReserveAmerica confirms an RV campground of Electric Plus sites (50 A, four at 30 A, one full hookup), 45-68 ft back-ins, showers, flush toilets, drinking water and a dump, open all year with modern facilities May to mid-October. The fees base was the basic rate, but basic camping here is the tent area on a hilly one-way road, so the RV base is Electric Plus: $25 off-season / $30 in season (quoted), full hookup $35. Water/sewer hookups cleared to unknown (only site 81 has them). Not waterfront confirmed. Pin is at the Hwy 12 entrance, ~360 m west of the campground.
